title.narrative: Enhancing Quality of School Infrastructure in Montenegro

description.narrative: The “Enhancing School Infrastructure in Montenegro ” (ESIM) project was designed to enhance the capacities of the Ministry of Education, Science and Innovation (MESI) for the management of educational infrastructure in Montenegro, including for planning and realisation of investments into improvements. It is funded by the European Investment Bank (EIB) and will be implemented in close collaboration with MESI.
